people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
translations.bsb: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
translations.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
translations.asv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.
